x: Powering up the hill, our reigning champion Phil Wicks was already locked in battle at the front alongside Wells City’s Frank Tickner, with other contenders Huw Lobb (Bedford) and Andy Vernon (Aldershot) electing to let these two rip chunks out of each other.

Phil was lying 31st as the first 1k lap was completed, ahead of team mates Skinner and Overall and close behind Tickner and Merrien. He continued in the mid to late 30s for the next 4.5k but drifted into the 40s over the last two circuits, finishing 45th.

The Beagles’ Keith Gerrard had been closing him down but as the race drew to a conclusion, Gerrard began to sag and then Moumin Geele fell away from the front and into Phil’s range. Our man was into 4th while Tickner again took over at the front.
